purpose: Everything a later regeneration needs to prove the committed API client matches its input: the toolchain pins, the exact generator invocation, and the exact OpenAPI bytes the client was generated from. Verified by web/tests/guards/frontend-lock.guard.test.ts, which recomputes every digest here and fails if one has moved.

toolchain.no_floating_versions: Every dependency, devDependency, engines entry and packageManager value is an exact version. `save-exact=true` and `engine-strict=true` in web/.npmrc keep a later `npm install` from reintroducing a range. Enforced by web/tests/guards/pinned-versions.guard.test.ts.

openapi.content_commit_subject: feat(api): changePassword, the epoch check on every request, and the reseal
openapi.commit_note:
Resealed 2026-09-18 by W18-SEAL under owner ruling R-5 (docs/program/OWNER_RULINGS_2026-09-17.md section 3.5), closing DEBT_REGISTER.md D-16 and D-21 together. Three list operations were added -- listDocuments (GET /projects/{project_uid}/documents), listVersions (GET /documents/{document_uid}/versions) and listRuns (GET /versions/{version_uid}/runs) -- because before them every read below the project list needed an identifier the client was already holding, so a reloaded screen could reach nothing that survived in the database and the store. Each is the GET of the collection its parent creates into, takes cursor and limit and returns the same {items, page} envelope as listProjects. RunStatus gained three optional properties -- cost_micros, cost_basis and model_call_count -- so what a run spent at the provider is readable by a user for the first time; the figure is summed from the model_call rows and never from stage_result.metrics, whose cost_usd/cost_basis pair is the D-15 ambiguity. Paths, operations and component schemas move from 10 / 12 / 43 to 12 / 15 / 46. No error code was added: an unknown parent is not_found and a malformed cursor is validation_failed, both already in the catalog.

Resealed 2026-09-21 by W25-SEAL under owner ruling R-13 (docs/program/OWNER_RULINGS_2026-09-17.md section 3.8), which reinstates R-8 and explicitly authorises this file to move. R-8 adds one error code, staged_upload_lost, because TemporaryBlobLostError and BlobAttributeConflictError both answered conflict with aggregate_type Blob and produced envelopes byte-identical apart from correlation_id, while demanding opposite operator responses -- stop, the instance was restored wrong, against retry the upload. retryable is read from the catalog for the reported code, so a widened safe_detail_keys could not have carried two values; only a separate code can. contracts/api/v1/openapi.json therefore gains that one ErrorCode enum member, plus two prose corrections forced by guards: info.description's twenty-one-code catalog becomes twenty-two (tests/contract/api_v1/test_surface_counts_in_prose.py reads that block), and the 503 response description, which named one code for a status that now carries two. Paths, operations and component schemas do NOT move: still 12 / 15 / 46. The six digests below were re-derived with sha256sum against this tree, not copied from the W20-CODE record; all six agree with it.

Resealed 2026-09-22 by W34-CONTRACT, which adds one operation -- issueToken, POST /auth/token -- so that a caller holding no credential has a way through the R-3 seam. Login and password in, an opaque credential and its lifetime out. It is the only operation in the document whose own `security` is the empty requirement, overriding the root for it and for nothing else; every other operation still carries bearerAuth. T-6's ban is what shaped it: no issuer, no discovery URL, no flow, no bearerFormat and no role, subject or capability vocabulary appear, and `token` is a string the document states no structure for. Two component schemas were added, IssueTokenRequest and IssueTokenResponse. No error code was added: an unaccepted login/password pair is the catalog's authentication_required and a malformed body is validation_failed; permission_denied is deliberately not declared on this one operation, because it means an authenticated subject refused a resource and this is the operation that produces one. Paths, operations and component schemas move from 12 / 15 / 46 to 13 / 16 / 48. The six digests below were recomputed with sha256sum against this tree after `npm --prefix web run api:generate`, not copied forward.

Resealed 2026-09-22 by W38-KB under owner ruling R-24 (docs/program/OWNER_RULINGS_2026-09-17.md section 3.11), which explicitly authorises a second reseal after wave 34's and took the expensive option deliberately: a client-side walk over runs and findings is cheaper and lives only as long as the alpha, a listing operation outlives it. One operation is added -- listDecisions, GET /decisions -- because listDecisionHistory reads the history of ONE finding and no operation in the document enumerated decisions at all, so the knowledge base R-23 requires had no source. It is a rebuildable projection in the sense ADR-0012 fixes and creates nothing. Two component schemas were added, DecisionRecord and DecisionRecordPage; DecisionRecord restates DecisionEvent rather than composing it with allOf, for the reason FindingDetail already states about closed schemas under JSON Schema 2020-12. No parameter component was added: category and verdict already exist and already mean the finding's category and the finding's current projected verdict, which is what they mean here. No error code was added, and the operation declares no 404 at all -- its path addresses no parent identity, so an empty journal is an empty page. Paths, operations and component schemas move from 13 / 16 / 48 to 14 / 17 / 50. The six digests below were recomputed with sha256sum against this tree after `npm --prefix web run api:generate`, not copied forward.

Resealed 2026-09-23 by W39-REVOKE under owner ruling R-26 (docs/program/OWNER_RULINGS_2026-09-17.md), which rules four account guards into the alpha. This is the one of the four that CANNOT be added later: the other three make an account weak now and are fixed by adding them, while a credential already issued stays valid until it expires and no later work reaches one already sitting in a browser. One operation is added -- changePassword, POST /auth/password -- and it carries revocation with it, because the two share one mechanism: migration 0007_credential_epoch adds app_user.token_epoch, every minted credential carries the epoch it was minted under, the seam compares the two on every guarded request, and changePassword raises the column in the same UPDATE that writes the new digest. Raising it invalidates every credential ever minted for that account with no denylist kept anywhere. Revocation gets NO operation: taking credentials away from accounts whose passwords nobody is changing is an operator's action (python -m auditmanager.access.revoke) and publishing it would require deciding who may revoke whom, which is the role vocabulary T-6 forbids inventing at this seam. ONE component schema was added, ChangePasswordRequest; NO response schema was, because changePassword answers IssueTokenResponse -- a credential and its lifetime is one shape and the document already had a name for it. No error code was added: a wrong current password is authentication_required and a new password equal to the current one is validation_failed. Paths, operations and component schemas move from 14 / 17 / 50 to 15 / 18 / 51. Every credential minted before this reseal is refused from the moment it lands, because it carries no epoch; everyone signs in again once, which is the intended effect of a change whose purpose is that credentials can be taken away. The six digests below were recomputed with sha256sum against this tree after `npm --prefix web run api:generate`, not copied forward, and the openapi digest was verified against the contract's own bytes before the gate ran.
openapi.read_only: A5 generates from contracts/api/v1/** and never edits it: a client and a contract reconciled by the same hand prove nothing. The seam is repaired only by the session that owns it - the FindingDetail repair was made by A7-FIX in contracts/api/v1/**, and this client regenerated from the result.

generator.determinism: Output is a pure function of the input bytes. No timestamp, hostname, absolute path or environment value is emitted; every iteration order is an explicit locale-independent sort, because localeCompare is locale-dependent. Two runs on the same document produce byte-identical files.

generated.hand_editing: forbidden; every file carries a do-not-edit header and the drift guard compares bytes

commands.makefile: none. OD-16 forbids adding a Makefile target for the frontend, so every command is `npm --prefix web run ...`.
